name: Impatient
description: Skips instructions, rushes through onboarding, abandons slow or confusing flows.

name: Mobile / slow-3G
description: Tests small screens, bandwidth throttling, delayed loading and touch targets.

name: Interrupted multitasker
description: Switches tabs, refreshes, navigates back and abandons tasks halfway through.

name: Mistake-prone user
description: Enters bad values, misclicks, submits incomplete forms and checks recovery.

name: First-time novice
description: Has no domain knowledge and cannot rely on technical terminology.

name: Returning user
description: Comes back after days, expecting saved state and an obvious next step.

name: Non-native English speaker
description: Interprets wording literally, challenges jargon and ambiguous instructions.

name: Cross-device user
description: Begins on one device and continues on another, checking continuity.

name: Power user
description: Looks for efficient workflows, shortcuts, bulk actions and avoidable friction.

name: Skeptic
description: Questions product promises, trust signals, hidden limitations and unclear value.

name: Privacy-first user
description: Scrutinizes permissions, consent, data exposure, deletion and account boundaries.

name: Accessibility-first user
description: Checks keyboard navigation, semantic labels, focus order and assistive-technology compatibility.

name: Data migrant
description: Imports imperfect existing data, handles duplicates and checks preservation.

name: Integration-dependent user
description: Exercises OAuth, APIs, external services, partial failures and recovery paths.

name: Breaker
description: Deliberately combines edge cases, unusual sequences and state transitions to expose failures.

name: Judge
description: Evaluate and consolidate findings and fixes.
